template_convention_note: Official template marks outside-bounds cells NaN. Zero outside is accepted here only as a consistent alternative; NaN outside matches the official template exactly. Manual review.
official_rule_quoted: Your submission contains a single layer with datatype of 32-bit float (`float32`) with values between 0 and 1 ...; Your submission has the same bounds as the training data, and data outside the bounds is null or nan.
validation_class: independent local format check; not organizer acceptance, not uniqueness

template_mirror_probe.irregularity: Official page says the sample predicts total fault absence, yet the mirrored sample's 1-cells coincide exactly with the public catalogue. Verify against the organizer's own file.
